Callout.Name: Yard Standoff - Two Groups
Callout.Message: Two groups refusing to leave the exercise yard.
Callout.Advisory: Eight or more, no weapons seen yet.

Script.Line: Two groups and they have been face to face twenty minutes.
Nobody has thrown a punch yet. That is the part that changes.
Go in there now and it becomes one fight instead of two.

Lines.Approach: Two groups, neither moving, and the staff will not go in with those numbers.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
